# Aretia Finance

> Aretia Finance (aretiafinance.org) is a multichain wallet and live token markets for Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Polygon and Robinhood Chain. It builds its markets from on-chain pool events with its own indexer and states where its data is thin. Aretia's own token funds a catalyst fund for early-stage climate projects. Aretia is not a bank, broker or financial adviser and does not rate tokens as investments.

## What it is, in facts you can check

- Markets page: https://aretiafinance.org/wallet (no account needed to browse). Shows price, 24-hour volume, transactions, traders, liquidity and age per pool.
- Networks covered by Markets: Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Polygon, Robinhood Chain.
- Data comes from Aretia's own indexer reading decentralised-exchange events from each chain. Pools below about $100 of liquidity are hidden by default; a dash means "not available", never zero.
- Self-custody: the wallet does not hold user funds. The browser-extension wallet is in development and is not yet published to the Chrome Web Store.
- Aretia charges a fee on swaps, shown on the review screen before confirmation.
- Some contracts are unaudited and are labelled as such.
